usedFor: Sangam CRM holds contracts and tickets, and Google Docs is where “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes them down.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contract Created” in Sangam CRM, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new contract can write its text into a chosen Doc tab, so the document is ready with the record.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so choose adding to keep what is there.
